'''Kashyk''' {{C|sic}} was a beverage served at [[Moshi Bar/Legends|Moshi Bar]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It was served in a brownish-purple bottle decorated with a yellow label stating the drink's name in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]]. The design of the label<ref name="Lethal Trackdown" /> was the same as the motif on ''[[Kashyk Welcomes You/Legends|Kashyk Welcomes You]]'', a [[Painting/Legends|poster]];<ref name="Catch" /> but without the last two words.<ref name="Lethal Trackdown" /> This poster seemed to function as both a travel advertisement for the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] and an ad for the beverage.<ref name="Catch">{{TCW|To Catch a Jedi}}</ref> A mirror-inverted, differently [[Color/Legends|colored]] version of this poster was put up at [[Terminal 24/Legends|Terminal 24]] in the Coruscant Underworld, along with mirror-inverted advertisements for the beverages [[Ryloth (beverage)/Legends|Ryloth]] and [[Phattro/Legends|Phattro]], which were also served at Moshi Bar.<ref name="Lethal Trackdown" />
